mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outbox_event (aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_type, payload) VALUES (#{aggregateType}, #{aggregateId}, #{eventType}, CAST(#{payload} AS JSON))
mapper.select: SELECT id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_type, payload, status, retry_count, next_retry_time, last_error, create_time, processed_time FROM outbox_event WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND next_retry_time <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE outbox_event SET status = 'PROCESSED', processed_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), last_error = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE outbox_event SET retry_count = retry_count + 1, status = CASE WHEN retry_count + 1 >= #{maxRetries} THEN 'DEAD' ELSE 'PENDING' END, next_retry_time = DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), INTERVAL #{delaySeconds} SECOND), last_error = LEFT(#{error}, 1000) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
